}}
The Columbine Genealogical and Historical Society is a local historical society formed in 1973. It is headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, although it moved to Good Shepherd Episcopal Church in 2021.
The society collects and publishes local records, and teaches genealogy and researching family history. The group has presentations and also classes held in partnership with local libraries. They also present in depth programs and workshops. They have a quarterly newsletter, The Columbine Leaves, which features articles on local history and genealogy, book reviews, and updates on the society's activities.
